**Collect play cards by opening** **card packs** **or using the marketplace**

Each Play card belongs to a **Category** and has **Traits**, **Rarity**, **Rating**, **Season**, **Serial #.**

The **traits** and **category** of a play card vary by sport.

* NBA
  * A Play card has **traits** such as "Fadeaway", "Game-winning", "Snipe", etc. and belongs to a **category**: Layup, Dunk, Midrange, Three, or Free Throws
* NFL
  * A Play card has **traits** such as "Beastmode", "Two minute drill", "First strike", "Dot", etc. and belongs to a **category**: Rush, Catch, Pass, Touchdown, Field Goal, Defense/ST

Each trait has a **rarity** which is associated with how often the trait occurs in the season.

* The rarities are **common, uncommon, rare, epic,** and **legendary.**

The **rating** of a Play card depends on game situations.

* Learn more about our rating system here.

>
A higher **rarity** doesn't always mean a higher **rating**. For instance, a "Snipe" trait has epic rarity. But, a Snipe during a 20-point deficit in the 2nd Quarter will be lower rated, whereas one in a close 4th Quarter will be higher rated.

Collecting Play cards allows you to...

* Boost the base Rax earnings of your Player and Team cards.

>
Play cards boost the **first** listed player on the card. Note for NFL, there are Pass and Catch versions of each passing play, one for the QB and one for the receiver.

* Fill your collector map, earn achievements, and climb leaderboards
* Join a community of collectors around the world
* Own your favorite sports moments

As you collect play cards, you can fill your collector map and earn achievements.

* Earn Team achievements by filling a minimum of 5 play cards associated to that team in the specific category on the map.
* Earn Player achievements by filling a minimum of 3 play cards associated to that player in the specific category on the map.

Climb leaderboards by filling your map with the highest rated plays in your collection

* A **red** dot on a trait on your map means that you have an available card to fill.
* A **white** dot on a trait on your map means that there is an available card with a higher rating.
